Packing backpack with laptop, lab coat and study notes for the day
Travelling to Monash Clayton campus for classes
Attending chemistry lectures and laboratory practical sessions at Monash Clayton
Having lunch at Monash Clayton campus with Member 1 and Member 3, aligned with their 12:00-13:00 lunch
Working a part-time lab assistant shift, preparing reagents and cleaning glassware
Unpacking backpack, changing into comfortable clothes and relaxing after campus
Having dinner with Member 1 and Member 3, sharing the dinner cooked by Member 3
Washing dishes and wiping down the kitchen counters after dinner
Studying chemistry notes and completing assignments on the computer with the desk lamp on

Charging phone and getting ready for bed
